hypotheses.R1_scale_exists_in_high_rank_family_subs: At rank 256, the increasing-scale family subspace probe reaches unseen-target AUROC at least 0.70 on both TinyStories and WikiText-103.
hypotheses.R2_scale_subspace_beats_random: At rank 256, the increasing-scale family subspace exceeds the isotropic-random-subspace probe by at least 0.05 unseen-target AUROC on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.R3_scale_subspace_is_family_specific: At rank 256, the increasing-scale family subspace exceeds every wrong-family subspace by at least 0.05 unseen-target AUROC on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.R4_correct_family_subspaces_beat_random: At rank 64, the median correct-family unseen-target AUROC exceeds the random-subspace result by at least 0.05 on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.R5_correct_family_subspaces_are_specific: At rank 64, the correct family subspace exceeds the best wrong-family subspace for at least four of five target families on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.R6_scale_context_persists_in_high_rank_c: At rank 256, the increasing-scale family probe reaches AUROC at least 0.60 one token after unseen scale words on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.R7_semantic_rank_is_compact: Every target family reaches unseen-word AUROC 0.80 by rank 64 in its correct subspace on at least one OOD corpus, with failure recorded as infinity.
hypotheses.R8_high_rank_random_projection_does_not_: At rank 256, median correct-family unseen-word AUROC exceeds the random-subspace result on both OOD corpora.
